name: Reese
source:
Reese is an eccentric chatterbox who loves lolita fashion and hosting tea parties. When she isn't throwing a party, she can be found in her room tailoring clothes. She's a social butterfly who attempts to befriend everyone.

[From [url=https://redpink-games.itch.io/alices-reverie-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
